_meta.title: Measured constants for the 2026-27 model, re-derived on 2026-11-19
_meta.rule: measure, never fit. Each constant states the official column it came from.

league.formula: sum(OffRtg_i * POSS_i) / sum(POSS_i) over the 30 official rows; PACE weighted by GP; the def side is the same weighting of the advanced DefRtg column, which is points allowed per 100 possessions

dispersion.formula: sample standard deviation (n-1) of the official home-minus-away margin and of the official game total, over every decided game in the results feed, de-duplicated by game id
dispersion.source_url: data/official/results_feed_2026_27.json (official finals, promoted from nba.com game-summary pages)

home_court_pin.sample: 111 home wins in 221 non-neutral home games (1 neutral-site pairs are excluded by the standings' own column)
home_court_pin.formula: HCA_points = sigma_margin * Phi^-1(home win rate); the rate comes from the official standings HOME/ROAD columns, never from a fit
